The '''Sorderia system''' was located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the material known as [[Sorderian weftfabric]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Sorderian weftfabric]]|system=Sorderia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sorderia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
